# HTTP API

This page lists the **generic** routes of inkpdf, generated from the locked OpenAPI document
(`openapi/openapi.json`).

A running instance publishes a richer document: `GET /openapi.json` adds one typed render
operation per template currently loaded (`POST /templates/<id>/render`, whose request body is
that template's own schema), and `GET /docs` renders it interactively. Point an OpenAPI
generator at a running instance to get a client typed per template.

Errors use RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` bodies; see [Error codes](errors.md).

## `GET /health`

**Process liveness**

| Status | Description |
|---|---|
| 200 | The process responds. |

## `GET /openapi.json`

**This document, in JSON format**

| Status | Description |
|---|---|
| 200 | OpenAPI 3.1 document. |

## `GET /packages`

**Packages available to templates**

Packages present only as dependencies of other packages are not listed: they
cannot be imported.

| Status | Description |
|---|---|
| 200 | Packages importable with `#import "@preview/<name>"`. |

## `GET /ready`

**Readiness (initial volume scan finished)**

| Status | Description |
|---|---|
| 200 | Ready. |
| 503 | Initial scan in progress. |

## `GET /templates`

**List the templates in the volume**

| Status | Description |
|---|---|
| 200 | Known templates, valid or invalid, sorted by identifier. |

## `GET /templates/{templateId}`

**Template detail, schema included**

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `templateId` | path | yes | Template identifier (its folder name). |

| Status | Description |
|---|---|
| 200 | Template detail. |
| 404 | Problem (Problem) |

## `POST /templates/{templateId}/render`

**Generate a PDF**

Validates the body against the template's schema (after applying the `default` values of
`layout`), then returns the PDF. No generation is attempted if validation fails.

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `templateId` | path | yes | Template identifier (its folder name). |
| `download` | query | no | `true`: respond as a download (`Content-Disposition: attachment`) instead of inline display. Values: `true`, `false`, `1`, `0`. |
| `filename` | query | no | File name (no path; `.pdf` appended). Default: `<templateId>.pdf`. |

Request body: `application/json`, schema `RenderRequest`.

| Status | Description |
|---|---|
| 200 | Generated document. |
| 400 | Problem (Problem) |
| 404 | Problem (Problem) |
| 409 | Problem (Problem) |
| 413 | Problem (Problem) |
| 415 | Problem (Problem) |
| 422 | Body does not match the template's schema. |
| 500 | Problem (Problem) |
| 503 | Problem (Problem) |
| 504 | Problem (Problem) |

## `GET /templates/{templateId}/schema`

**Raw JSON Schema of the template input**

Usable directly by a validator or a form generator.

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `templateId` | path | yes | Template identifier (its folder name). |

| Status | Description |
|---|---|
| 200 | JSON Schema (draft 2020-12). |
| 404 | Problem (Problem) |
| 409 | Problem (Problem) |
